content: Jesusangka binal-bungan divorcemunku.
Wawu yinyamun kukumun, jana Jesus bubumun Galileemun dungarin. Jana ngubar-ngubar wawubajanga Jordan dungarin bubungu Judea.
Bamangka wubuldu nyungun wukurrin. Nyulu bambay-bambay ngulkurr-bungan yinyaymba.

Kanbal Pharisee-warra Jesusanda kadarin, nyungun kukubu walu ngangkal-ngangkal-bunganka, catchim-bunganka. Jana babajin, “Wanyu nganandamundu ngujakuramundu balkal manyarrinyunku? Yalada dunyungku manyarr bawalarrkukuda, nyuyanya?”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Yurra nguba kariku Godundumunbu kabanba yanyu kuku nyajin,

content.text: ‘Jakalbaku Godungku bama balkan, nyulu dingkar and jalbu balkan.’

content: Godungku yalaman,

content.text: ‘Yinyaynka nyulu dingkarangka nyungu nganjan and ngamu bawa, nyunguwunji manyarranji bundayarrku. Bula manyarrinyumalda, yala nyubunkuda.’”

content: Jesusangka yalaman baja, “Bula karida jambul, nyubunkuda, manyarrinyukuda. Kaki Godungku dingkar and jalbu kuna-bungal, bamangka kari ngami-ngami-bunga baja. Manyarrinyu kari bawawaka baja.”
Jana Pharisee-warrangka Jesusanda yalaman, “Mosesangka yanyu kuku balkan,

content.text: ‘Kaki dunyungku nyungu manyarr bawanka, nyulu nyungundu kaban daya divorcemunku, nyungun bawada.’

content: Mosesangka wanyurrinku yinya kuku balkan?”

Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Mosesangka yinya kuku balkan yurranka. Yurra dukul-dandi bajaku, wawu kari binalmanka. Nganjin wumbabuku yurranin binal-bungan-bungal. Mosesangka yinya kuku divorcemunku balkan, yurra dukul-dandimanya. Yinya kuku Godundumun kari, jakalbamun kari.

Ngayu yurranda balkal, manyarr nyubun nguba ngulkurrku bunday, yindu kari dunyu-bungal. Nyunguwundu dunyungku nyungun kari bawa. Yamba dunyungku nguba bawal, yindu manyarr-bunganka. Nyulu dingkar kalngarmalda.”
Jawun-karrangka yalamanda, “Kaki bamangka yinya kuku wukurrinka, nguba ngulkurr kari marrymanka.”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Kari. Ngulkurr bama manyarrinyumanka. Yamba kanbal bama kari marrymanka. Godungku jananin junkurr dajil junkayku bundanka.

Kanbal dingkar-dingkar kari marrymal, jana can't nganjanmanya. Jana yalaku balkajin. Kanbal can't nganjanmal, bamangka jananin yalaku buyun-damanya. Kanbal kari marrymanka, jana Godunku workmanka, nyungu kuku mumbarku yirrkanka. Kaki jana wawubu, yinya ngulkurr, jana ngulkurrku bundari.”
Jesus kaykay-kaykayanka wawu.

Yinyamun bamangka kaykay-kaykay Jesusanda wundin. Jana wawu nyulu Jesusangka kaykay-kaykay marabu karrbanka, Godunji balkawanka, praymanijinka yinyarrinyanka kaykay-kaykayanka. Yamba jana jawun-karrangka 12-balangka yinyarrin bama murru-kangan.

Jesusangka yalaman, “Kaykay-kaykay kari kiri ngaykundu kadarinka. Balu kadarika ngaykundu. Kaki bamangka nganya kuku nyajil yala yinyarrinyangka kaykay-kaykayangka, Godungku jananin ngulkurrduku kujil.”
Nyulu Jesusangka jananin kaykay-kaykay marabu karrban, yinyamun nyulu dunganda.
Kuku dingkaranka nyubunyinka rich-balanka.
Nyubun warru Jesusanda kadan, babajin, “Maja, ngayu wanjarrmanka, junkayku bundanka, wuljaljiku juranku bundanka heavenba?”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Yundu wanyurrinku ngaykundu babaji ngulkurrku bundanka? Nyubunku ngulkurrkuda, Godku. Kaki yundu wuljaljiku juranku bundanka, yundu Godumu kuku wukurrika.”
Warrungku babajin, “Wanjarrku kuku Godumu?” Jesusangka yalaman,

content.text: “Kari yarkinkaku kuni, kari kalngarmaka, kari wurrmaymaka, kari jurrilmaka.
Kuku nyakaku, ngamu, nganjan; bamanka wubulkuku wawu jirray yala yundu yununkuku wawu jirray.”

content: Nyulu warrungku yalaman, “Ngayu karrkaymunku yinya kuku wukurrin. Ngayu wanjarrmal baja?”

Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Kaki yundu wuljaljiku juranku bundanka heavenba, dungayda, yamba-yamba wubulku sellim-bunga. Kulji money mana, jawun-karinda poor-balanda daya. Yinyamundu yundu jirray manil heavenba. Kadayda, nganya wukurrikada.”
Nyulu warrungku yinya kuku nyajin, nyulu milka-bujarku dungan, money jirray bajaku.
Jesusangka jawun-karranda yalamanda, “Ngayu yurranda balkal, Godungku nyungu bama ngulkurrduku kujil. Money-jirrayanka hard-bala God maja-bunganka. Nyulu milkanga moneyjiku bundanday.
Ngayu balkal baja, hard-bala bulki needledarr kankaburr dungay. Kaki bama money jirray, hard-bala bajaku God maja-bunganka.”
Jana jawun-karrangka yinya kuku nyajin, kungkurr-kadarin. Balu Godungku bama money jirray juran-bunganka. Jana yalaman, “Kaki yinya kuku manubaja, wanju baja Godungku juran-bungal?”
Jesusangka junkaynjaku nyajin jananin, yalaman, “Bamangka can't yalaku balkal. Godungkuku bama juran-bungalarrku.”
Peterangka yalamanda, “Yala nganjin? Nganjin wubulku bawan, jawun-karra, bayan, yamba-yamba, yunun wukurrinka. Nganjin wanyu manil yinyaynka?”

Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Ngayu manubajabuku balkal, ngayu yurranin juma maja-bungal yala-yalala ngayu kingmal. Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Juma ngayu majamal, ngayku bama wubulku ngulkurrduku kujil. Yurra 12-bala majamari, bama Jew-warra ngulkurrduku kujil. Jana Jew-warra kadarin yaba-yabajundumun 12-balandamun ngadimunku.

Kaki yurra junjuy-junjuy bawalarrku ngaykunku, ngayu yurranda jarra jirray dajil baja. Yurra nguba bayan, yaba-yabaju, babarr-jinkurr, ngamu, nganjan, kangkal-kangkal, bubu, wubulku bawanyarrku ngaykunku. Ngayu juma yurranin wubul bajaku dajil baja. Ngayu yalarrku yurranga wawu juran-bungal, yurra wuljaljiku ngaykunji bundanka heavenba.

Bama nguba majamanka, jakalba yindu-yinduymbu majaku dunganka ngaykuwunbu bubungu. Godungku nyungun kari maja-bungal. Bama yindu nguba wawu kari majamanka, nyulu yindu-yindu helpim-bunganka. Godungku nyungun maja-bungalkuda, nyunguwunbu bubungu.”
